name: What type of caulk is best for exterior siding in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What type of caulk is best for exterior siding in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exterior siding in the Bay Area, elastomeric caulks, such as polyurethane or polysulfide, are generally recommended. These types offer superior flexibility, adhesion, and durability, allowing them to withstand the region's temperature fluctuations and occasional moisture. While acrylic latex caulk is less expensive, it tends to crack and degrade faster. Silicone caulk is also durable but can be challenging to paint over and may not adhere well to all siding materials. We typically recommend professional-grade polyurethane for its long-lasting performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Elastomeric caulks like polyurethane or polysulfide are best for Bay Area siding due to their flexibility, adhesion, and durability against varying weather.
